title: $9,150 Or $10,400. Which One?
hook: Rolex Datejust 41 (blue dial, $9,150) vs Omega Moonwatch Professional Black and White ($10,400). Vote in the comments.
why: Interactive pick, but the price gap is about 14%, above the roughly 10% same-money rule. Needs owner decision or a closer partner.
